name: Lenticular Wallpaper
tagline: 在 iOS 16–18 上随设备倾斜呈现趣味壁纸切换与视差效果。
description: 趣味壁纸会随设备倾斜在多张预设壁纸间动态切换，呈现类似光栅卡片的视差效果。
支持 APNG 动画、多种切换方式，以及可选的角度光效。
notice: ⚠️ 使用前请在“照片”App 中创建名为「Banana」的相册，并将壁纸图片放入其中。最多读取 9 张图片。
features: 随设备倾斜切换预设壁纸
支持 APNG 动画播放
淡入淡出、棱镜光栅、磨砂玻璃与景深切换效果
可选的角度光效与两种光效样式
支持 English、简体中文和繁體中文
usage: 安装后打开“设置”中的趣味壁纸。
开启总开关与壁纸功能。
选择需要的切换效果，并按需启用 APNG 播放或角度光效。
点击“打开设置”进入壁纸配置面板。

changes: 新增 APNG 动画播放开关。
新增淡入淡出、棱镜光栅、磨砂玻璃和景深四种壁纸切换效果。
增强壁纸切换的连贯性、可配置性与多语言显示。

en.name: Lenticular Wallpaper
en.tagline: Tilt your device for playful wallpaper transitions and parallax effects on iOS 16–18.
description: Lenticular Wallpaper switches between prepared wallpapers as you tilt your device, creating a lenticular-style parallax effect.
It supports APNG playback, multiple transition styles, and optional angle-responsive lighting.
en.notice: ⚠️ Before use, create an album named “Banana” in the Photos app and add your wallpaper images. Up to 9 images are loaded.
features: Switch between prepared wallpapers as the device tilts
Cross-fade, Prism, Frosted Glass, and Depth transitions
Optional angle-responsive lighting with two visual styles
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Open Lenticular Wallpaper in Settings after installation.
Enable the main switch and wallpaper effects.
Choose a transition style and optionally enable APNG playback or angle-responsive lighting.
Tap Open Settings to enter the wallpaper configuration panel.

changes: Added Cross-fade, Prism, Frosted Glass, and Depth wallpaper transitions.
Improved transition smoothness, customization, and multilingual presentation.
